params.name: route_id_or_external_id
params.description: ID of the route. This can either be the Samsara-specified ID, or an external ID. External IDs are customer specified key-value pairs created in the POST or PATCH requests of this resource. To specify an external ID as part of a path parameter, use the following format: `key:value`. For example, `payrollId:ABFS18600`
